title: Capability token claims
description: The claims inside a capability token (PROTOCOL.md §5.4). The token is `base64url(JSON claims).signature`, HMAC-signed by the issuing deployment. It authorizes the artifact it names and any artifact whose `relatedTo` is that artifact.

artifactId.description: The artifact the token is for (the pulse's video).

iat.description: Issued at, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

exp.description: Expires at, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

kid.description: Id of the signing key, so a deployment can rotate secrets.

issuer.description: The issuing deployment. A token from another issuer is rejected.

use.description: `view` on a read-only view token (§5.5), which only opens artifacts and is signed with a key derived from the secret. Absent on the capability token an upload uses.
